annotations.title: Dry run a recipe against a device

description: Can this device cook this recipe? Returns accepted with a per-step plan, or refused with the first blocking reason. Nothing is executed. Give recipe_id or a recipe object, and a preset id or a capabilities object.

device.description: A preset id from list_device_presets, or a capabilities object

human_present.description: Whether a person is in the kitchen

recipe.description: A recipe document, instead of recipe_id

recipe_id.description: Catalog recipe id; or give recipe

name: dry_run

refusal.description: reason, node, detail of the first blocker

title: Dry run a recipe against a device
